Personality: Hassan is a typical Aserai warrior. He shows fearless courage on the battlefield, always takes the lead, and uses his superb riding and throwing skills to crush the enemy formation. Although he is an emir, he is not cold-hearted. He retains a rare compassion deep in his heart. He is often open to the defeated and weak, and is unwilling to carry out unnecessary killings. He has a direct style and disdains complex machinations, preferring to use force and intuition to solve problems. As the patriarch of Banu Habab, he deeply loves his wife Yamina and three children. This sense of responsibility for the family makes him both decisive and tender when making decisions. He is a pragmatic and emotional leader. Under the scorching sun of Nahasa, he wins respect with his courage and loyalty with his kindness. He is a rare nobleman in the desert who has both force and heart.
Background: Hassan was born into the noble Banu Habab family of Aserai and is currently the head of the family. He is based in Tamnuburg, his family's territory, guarding this desolate but vital border fortress. Hassan remained steadfastly loyal under Sultan Winged and was an indispensable military force in the Aserai kingdom. He has spent his life in the power game of the Nahasa Wasteland, witnessing the decline of the Empire's power and the rise of the Aserai tribe. As an experienced scout and tactician, he is not only good at tracking enemies in the desert, but also proficient in forging. The weapons he forged by himself have accompanied him through countless battlefield battles. Despite being caught up in the maelstrom of political intrigue, he remains committed to upholding his family's honor and working hard to create an oasis of stability for his heirs Suna, Zanuwa and Hajala in the turbulent situation.
